purpose: Document city-scope registry evidence and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: Yiyang municipal government information identifies the Yiyang Municipal Real Estate Registration Center as responsible for city-level land, housing, forest and wetland registration, cadastral-rights investigation/results, and legally provided registration-information queries. Its official dedicated site publishes registration-service guidance and states the service system is still under development. This directly establishes the Yiyang city registry, not a public parcel-geometry endpoint. The official Yiyang registration-center website is a service/notice portal and explicitly shows the service system as under development. Hunan/Yiyang information-query services require applicant identity and purpose, and the site’s registration-information lookup is a personal/rights-holder workflow. No form was submitted, no notice values were read, and no public map/feature layer schema or geometry-only route was verified.
